detail: Mixed A/B/C — one more targeted probe before any long soak.
recommendation: Stop dyn scaling. Either accept curve as orthographic/path substrate, or change pen/state (not more attn on same ink).
honest_summary: A: endpoint z fully determined by last ~24 chars (cos=1.0) — no prefix context at readout point. B: paraphrases only mildly closer than random; near-identical spelling with different meaning is closer than paraphrases — form>>meaning. C: sentence shuffle changes whole-window z a lot — path/order sensitivity, not proof of discourse understanding. Practical call: do NOT scale dyn for understanding; curve currently script/path engine with suffix-dominated state.
